Class Point3

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Point3
public class Point3 extends Object
Represents a point in 3D space with x, y, z coordinates.

Design goal: zero garbage in hot paths (ray tracing inner loops). Every method that can mutate this and return this does so. Methods that are documented as ALLOCATES are kept only because their signature has no pre-allocated target parameter to write into; they are not meant to be called from per-pixel / per-ray hot paths. Prefer the GC-friendly overload (the one that takes a target parameter) wherever one is available.

    • subtractToVector

      public Vector3 subtractToVector(Point3 other)
      Returns the vector from this point to another point: other - this.

      ALLOCATES a new Vector3 - signature has no target parameter, so allocation cannot be avoided here. Use subtractToVector(Point3, Vector3) in any hot path.

      Semantics note (kept identical to the original implementation to avoid breaking existing call sites): despite the "subtract" name, the result points from this toward other (i.e. other - this), not this - other. Callers that need a "toward the camera" / "toward this point" direction should call it as target.subtractToVector(origin) to get origin - target, or negate the result.

      Parameters:
      other - The other point
      Returns:
      A new Vector3 representing (other - this)
